### Compare TAI-seq with other technologies
ATAC
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=4}


data <- read_tsv("source_fig_1c.tsv")

ggplot(data = data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = x), width = 0.3, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = TRUE, outlier.shape = NA, notch = FALSE, fill = "lightGrey", size = 0.3) +
  geom_violin(aes(color = type), adjust = 1, trim = TRUE, width = 0.6, fill = NA, size = 0.5, scale = "width") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 30, hjust = 1, color = c("red", "red", "black", "black", "black", "black", "black")),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#364070', colorRampPalette(c('#364070', '#3A64BC', '#4e8fcf', '#2ed978'))(6))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7), labels = c("TAI-seq 37", "TAI-seq 50", "10X multiome", "SHARE-seq", "Paired-seq", "sci-CAR-seq", "SNARE-seq")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(2, 6.1)) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab(expression(log[10]~(fragments~per~cell))) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 1, y = 6, colour = "red", size = 3.5, angle = 30, label = round(median(data[data$type == "JoINT-seq 37",]$counts))) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 2, y = 6, colour = "red", size = 3.5, angle = 30, label = round(median(data[data$type == "JoINT-seq 50",]$counts))) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 3, y = 6, colour = "black", size = 3.5, angle = 30, label = round(median(data[data$type == "10X multiome",]$counts))) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 4, y = 6, colour = "black", size = 3.5, angle = 30, label = round(median(data[data$type == "SHARE-seq",]$counts))) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 5, y = 6, colour = "black", size = 3.5, angle = 30, label = round(median(data[data$type == "Paired-seq",]$counts))) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 6, y = 6, colour = "black", size = 3.5, angle = 30, label = round(median(data[data$type == "sci-CAR-seq",]$counts))) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 7, y = 6, colour = "black", size = 3.5, angle = 30, label = round(median(data[data$type == "SNARE-seq",]$counts)))

```

### TCR/BCR coverage
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=4}

  data <- read_tsv("source_fig_1e.tsv")
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = data %>% dplyr::filter(chain == "TRA"), aes(color = group, x = percentile, y = y), linewidth = 0.8, lineend = "round") +
    geom_line(data = data %>% dplyr::filter(chain == "TRB"), aes(color = group, x = percentile, y = y), linewidth = 0.8, lineend = "round") +
    geom_line(data = data %>% dplyr::filter(chain == "IGH"), aes(color = group, x = percentile, y = y), linewidth = 0.8, lineend = "round") +
    geom_line(data = data %>% dplyr::filter(chain == "IGL"), aes(color = group, x = percentile, y = y), linewidth = 0.8, lineend = "round") +
    ylim(c(0, 7)) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_color_manual(values = imgt_colors) +
    ylab('log10(reads)') +
    xlab('Position percentile (%)') +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13))

```

### Detection rate of TCR/BCR
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=4}

### TCR
meta <- read_tsv("source_fig_1f_TCR.tsv") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(group), ~factor(., levels = c("undetected", "tra_only", "trb_only", "paired")))
meta$prop <- meta$prop*0.01
ggplot(meta, aes(x = sample)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = group, y = prop), position = "fill") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("undetected" = "grey90", "tra_only" = "#FCD48F", "trb_only" = "#FF9F01", "paired" = "#EE3B00")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  annotate("text", size = 4, color = "white", fontface = "bold", x = 1, y = meta$prop[meta$group == "paired"] - 0.03, label = paste0(round(100 * meta$prop[meta$group == "paired"], digits = 0), "%" )) 

### BCR
meta <- read_tsv("source_fig_1f_BCR.tsv") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(group), ~factor(., levels = c("undetected", "igl_only", "igh_only", "paired")))
meta$prop <- meta$prop*0.01
ggplot(meta, aes(x = sample)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = group, y = prop), position = "fill") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("undetected" = "grey90", "igl_only" = "#FCD48F", "igh_only" = "#FF9F01", "paired" = "#EE3B00")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  annotate("text", size = 4, color = "white", fontface = "bold", x = 1, y = meta$prop[meta$group == "paired"] - 0.03, label = paste0(round(100 * meta$prop[meta$group == "paired"], digits = 0), "%" ))
  coord_fixed(2.5)

```

### PBMC clustering
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}




data <- read_tsv('source_fig_1i.tsv')
ggplot(data, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = celltype_minor))  +
  geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_celltype_minor) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  coord_fixed((max(data$UMAP_1) - min(data$UMAP_1)) / (max(data$UMAP_2) - min(data$UMAP_2)))


```

### TCR projection
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}

data <- read_tsv('source_fig_1j.tsv')
data_tcr <- data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(n_clonotype)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!str_detect(cell_module, "B")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!str_detect(cell_module, "Mono")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!str_detect(cell_module, "DC")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!str_detect(cell_module, "HSC"))
xrange <- max(data$UMAPCombined_1) - min(data$UMAPCombined_1)
yrange <- max(data$UMAPCombined_2) - min(data$UMAPCombined_2)
ggplot(data) +
  geom_scattermore(aes(x = UMAPCombined_1, y = UMAPCombined_2), color = "grey90", show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  coord_fixed(xrange/yrange) +
  geom_point(data = data_tcr, aes(x = UMAPCombined_1, y = UMAPCombined_2, size = n_clonotype, color = minor_celltype), alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.1, 4), breaks = c(1, 5, 10)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_celltype_minor)


```

### Compare TAI with 10X
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}


  ppdata <- read_tsv('source_fig_1l.tsv')
  
  pat <- 'D1'
  sp <- cor(ppdata$prop_10X, ppdata$prop_TAI, method = "spearman")
  sp <- round(sp, 2)
  ggplot(ppdata, aes(x = prop_10X, y = prop_TAI)) +
    # scale_x_log10() +
    # scale_y_log10() +
    geom_point(aes(fill = CDR3a_CDR3b), show.legend = FALSE, size = 5, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black") +
    geom_line(stat="smooth", method = "lm", formula = y ~ x,
              size = 1, linetype ="dashed", alpha = 0.5, color = "blue") +
    theme_classic() +
    ylab("TAI") +
    xlab("10X") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = c("black", "black")),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = choose_colorset("bubble", nrow(ppdata))) +
    ggtitle(paste0(pat, "_", sp))

```

### Clonotype TF enrichment
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
pdata <- read_tsv('source_fig_1m_025.tsv')
pos <- position_jitter(width = 0.4, height = 0, seed = 18)
ggplot(pdata, aes(x = cluster, y = mean_diff, color = fill, group = cluster)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 6, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 80, r = 80, b = 80, l = 80, unit = "pt"),
        aspect.ratio = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(size = `-log10p`), alpha = 0.8, position = pos) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5), linetype = 2, color = '#CAC3F2') +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 3)) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = colorRampPalette(colors = c("#14B3FF", "#88CEEF", "#C1D5DC", "#EAD397", "#FDB31A", "#E42A2A"))(256), limits = c(-0.25, 0.25)) +
  ylab("Mean difference compared to background") +
  labs(color = 'Mean\ndifference') +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(ticks = FALSE, draw.ulim = FALSE, draw.llim = FALSE, 
                               theme = theme(legend.ticks = element_blank()))) +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(ticks = FALSE, draw.ulim = FALSE, draw.llim = FALSE, 
                                theme = theme(legend.ticks = element_blank()))) 
  
```
